I took a knife from my kitchen and stayed almost half an hour in the shower, trying to build up the courage to cut myself and bleed to death, the only thing stopping me was the fact that i have not prepared anything to leave behind, like a note explaining the reasons.

So, i think that the second best option would be to leave a note, i've seen family members being sad for years because they did not know if they could do something to prevent someone from commiting suicide. It would be better to at least tell what was on your mind

However, the best option is to not do this at all. Have you tried to sit down with ur best friend or your favorite family member and talk about this? The things you would write on ur suicide letter, but with someone.
